data.long_meaning: The meaning of Aeneus is recorded in name-lists as “Divine, God-given”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aeneus expresses “Divine, God-given”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aeneus total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
